### Risks

- An overview is a projection, not a management database or a new Curator queue.

### Acceptance criteria

- Every overview entry has an exact permitted source/Task reference; current completion resolves from canonical Task state.
- Director, Curator and sub-agent outputs use their actual scopes and phase restrictions; aggregation/search cannot expose sealed or unrelated content.
- Explicit overview rebuild updates only derived files, preserves source/receipt/Task hashes and supplies bounded remaining coverage.
- Implementation begins only after both task-local native pilots pass their applicable criteria; aggregation is included in the release and not deferred.

### Planned verification

- Run one focused aggregation integration check with permitted/denied entries from the existing two pilot boards, a ledger-derived status and before/after hashes; reuse all unchanged helper tests.

| Parallel group | None |

### Risks

- A watcher can publish validated sources early; keep the stage manifest explicit and do not claim distribution is runtime adoption.

### Acceptance criteria

- An exact reviewed source/destination manifest and pipeline receipts demonstrate all mapped package, contract and role bytes in the neutral Template.
- Dynamic skill discovery is reused; initializer/mapping fields or editions change only when the existing inventory demonstrably needs them, preserving historical receipt semantics.
- No populated posts, pilot/native identities, project grants, Task records or runtime state enter reusable starter assets; mapped Template files are not directly edited.
- Active depot root, products, Aether-Flow and registry remain outside the distribution write manifest.

### Planned verification

- Run tools/template_update.py check with its documented exact project arguments, review the bounded manifest, apply that manifest, and confirm the final affected-file mapping; use no broad suite.

## TASK-015 - Verify confined setup and adoption boundaries

Exercise only the selected collaboration setup/adoption boundary in disposable new and existing project fixtures within an isolated fixture depot with its own registry/control records, using the established initializer or an exact separately authorized package adoption manifest without broadening product scope.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-019, REQ-032, REQ-036, REQ-040, REQ-046, REQ-047, REQ-048, REQ-049, REQ-050, REQ-058, REQ-060, REQ-063 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | Verification/shared-agent-billboards/adoption/previews.json, Verification/shared-agent-billboards/adoption/preservation-manifest.json |
| Dependencies | TASK-014 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- An initializer may not expose an existing collaboration-adopt module; do not invent a CLI route or silently relabel its receipt edition.

### Acceptance criteria

- The new fixture obtains the neutral package from the Template; the existing fixture preview names exact source, destination, files, preservation and overwrite boundaries.
- Customized unrelated guidance/content and historical setup/Task meanings are preserved; conflicting customized selected targets stop rather than get overwritten.
- One bounded read/rebuild check in the explicitly selected fixture verifies installed package links and derived-only output with the already-proved common-store topology.
- Only the isolated fixture registry may record its actual fixtures; the live depot registry, unselected root/product files, Aether-Flow, services and Git state are preserved. Future-project runtime behavior and live consumer adoption are not claimed.

### Planned verification

- Use two small disposable fixtures for new and existing setup/adoption. Review exact preview/receipt hashes and run only the affected starter/adoption validation, reusing pilot/helper evidence.
